plan: My private value is $27. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid your true value. If I bid exactly $27, I'll win only if my bid is the highest, and I'll pay the second-highest bid. This minimizes overpaying while maximizing my chance of winning when the prize is worth more to me than to others. Since values are randomly drawn, bidding my true value is statistically the best long-term approach.
